engineCapabilities.title: Four-engine capability overview
engineCapabilities.description: Codex, Claude, Grok, and OpenCode all support start, stop, restart, and resume. Restart means stopping the current run and starting again, not resuming an old CLI session. All four engines run in non-interactive batch mode and do not support sending input during a live session.

notes.codex: Supports start/stop/resume/mid-session input (SDK channel keeps stdin; send_codex_input while running). Restart = stop current run then start again (not CLI resume of an old session). CLI batch channel has no stdin; send returns an explicit error.
notes.claude: Supports start/stop/resume/mid-session input (SDK bridge keeps stdin). Restart = stop current run then start again (not CLI resume of an old session). CLI batch channel does not support mid-session input.
notes.opencode: Supports start/stop/resume/mid-session input (SDK bridge keeps stdin; append prompts on the same OpenCode session). Restart = stop current run then start again (not CLI resume of an old session).
notes.grok: Supports start/stop/resume. Restart = stop current run then start again (not CLI resume of an old session). Grok is a headless CLI (-p + Stdio::null) with no writable mid-session stdin (B1 exemption).

tester.title: Tester automation (test before review)
tester.description: After a dev session ends successfully, run acceptance tests first and enter automated code review only if they pass. Command failures are hard failures and cannot be overruled by AI alone.
tester.disabledNotice: Currently disabled. Enabling it is recommended so completed tasks automatically go through tester acceptance before review; otherwise it can look like the tester does nothing. You can also see a prompt at the top of the Kanban board.
tester.enableDescription: When disabled, the old path remains: execution goes straight into review after completion.
tester.allowAiOnlyTitle: Allow AI or checklist-only acceptance when no test command is configured
tester.allowAiOnlyDescription: Results are more subjective when no test command is configured. If disabled, the automated path skips the test phase.
tester.defaultTestCommandPlaceholder: For example npm test or cargo test
tester.defaultTestCommandDescription: Projects can override this separately. Local mode runs it in the working directory, and SSH mode runs it in the matching remote directory.

Restoring SQL does not automatically restore prompt templates, MCP config, attachment files, or secrets; also back up the app config directory and task-attachments/, or use “Open database directory” on the Settings page to locate related data.

Sensitive secrets in the keyring such as SSH passwords/private-key passphrases
ai-prompt-templates.json in the app config directory (AI prompt templates)
